description: This file defines API endpoints for user management in a FastAPI application, including registration, login, profile retrieval, profile updating, and preferences updating. It interacts with an SQLAlchemy database session and uses JSON serialization for user preferences and bookmarks.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents the user model with fields like id, email, preferences, bookmarks, and password hash.

methods.name: UserOut _user_to_out(u: User)
methods.description: Converts a User model instance to a UserOut schema, parsing JSON fields for bookmarks and preferences.

methods.name: register(payload: UserRegisterIn)
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with email and password, checking for existing email.

methods.name: login(payload: UserLoginIn)
methods.description: Endpoint for user login that verifies credentials and issues an access token.

methods.name: get_profile(id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"))
methods.description: Retrieves user profile data by user ID.

methods.name: patch_profile(id: int, payload: UserProfileUpdateIn, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates user profile data and preferences, ensuring user permissions.

ctags.name: get_profile
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_profile(id: int = Path(..., description="User ID")):$/

ctags.name: patch_profile
ctags.pattern: /^async def patch_profile(id: int, payload: UserProfileUpdateIn, user=Depends(get_current_user)):$/
